instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: You can make ((interest)) on your money at the bank.
atoms.finishSound: You can make interest on your money at the bank.

atoms.b: Most written ((material)) can be found online.
atoms.finishSound: Most written material can be found online.

atoms.b: A ((possession)) is something that you own.
atoms.finishSound: A possession is something that you own.

atoms.b: We use ((medicine)) to recover from illnesses.
atoms.finishSound: We use medicine to recover from illnesses.
The woman was a complete stranger.

atoms.b: The attractions were out of the ((ordinary)).
atoms.finishSound: The attractions were out of the ordinary.

atoms.b: She wanted to wear a ((peculiar)) outfit.
atoms.finishSound: She wanted to wear a peculiar outfit.
